validation.rule: SYSTEM.md 1.5: >=6 winners from >=4 channels, no channel > 1/3, >=3 weak contrasts, drivers counted

conflict_hook.label: driver
conflict_hook.target: the first 2 s are a character's challenge or a shock statement of the story's conflict (Goliath's 'Who will fight me?!', Satan's 'Look at you...'), never atmosphere or narration

antagonist_or_spectacle.label: driver
antagonist_or_spectacle.target: the story is told through its conflict: a giant, a tempter, a judgment, a flood; the moment with the most at stake is the one shown

acted_dialogue.label: hygiene
acted_dialogue.target: characters act and speak their lines, lip-synced, faces visible

full_motion.label: free (winners 5/5, weak 1/2)
full_motion.target: cinematic motion in every shot; no 2.5D animated stills

host_on_screen.label: absent
host_on_screen.note: no winner has a narrator on screen: the Keeper is our own hypothesis, not a measured driver

length_s.note: every measured Short is longer than our 62-90 s rule

lesson_share.note: a lesson of at most about a quarter; the weak Noah Short spent 41 % preaching

sound.label: hygiene
sound.note: orchestral score with choir swells and foley (armor, stone, wind) in every video

conflict_check.policy: AI label normal in the niche; no fabricated prophecy; Scripture paraphrased by winners, KJV exact here
